description: This file contains Kotlin source code defining a multi-step onboarding flow for an Android app, including multiple fragments for welcome, goals, duration, analytics, and finish screens, each with specific guidance and user actions.

classes.name: WelcomeOnboardingFragment
classes.description: Fragment for welcome screen with options to proceed or skip onboarding.

classes.name: GoalsOnboardingFragment
classes.description: Fragment for goal selection with checkboxes, navigating to duration selection.

classes.name: DurationOnboardingFragment
classes.description: Fragment for selecting preferred workout duration with radio options.

classes.name: AnalyticsOnboardingFragment
classes.description: Fragment for opting into analytics tracking with a checkbox.

classes.name: FinishOnboardingFragment
classes.description: Final fragment marking onboarding as complete and exiting.

methods.name: onCreateGuidance
methods.description: Creates guidance content for each onboarding step.

methods.name: onCreateActions
methods.description: Initializes actions (buttons, checkboxes) in each fragment.

methods.name: actionToGoalId
methods.description: Converts action title back to goal IDs.
